beats.say: Michael Jackson broke records by winning eight Grammy Awards.
That single night brought more trophies than most musicians receive across an entire decade.
The record breaking album earned eight American Music Awards alongside those historic wins.
Beat It captured Record of the Year to cement the project's massive global reach.
The Library of Congress later added the masterpiece to the National Recording Registry.
It also entered the Grammy Hall of Fame to secure its lasting musical legacy.
Combining 37 weeks at number one with eight Grammys made this release unmatched.
Which song on the album do you listen to the most?
